fit_reason: Whole passenger sedan listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Steering wheel rim shows a worn, shiny, grimy grip area at the top and sides

message: Hi, we saw your Impala listing and it looks like a solid car. In the photos the steering wheel and dash are showing some wear and dust, and the dark paint up front could use some gloss back. We do mobile pre-sale details, inside and out, and come to you. Would you like a quote?
